record.name: Brex
record.one_liner: Brex provides a unified spend platform with a public REST API using Bearer token authentication to manage corporate cards, expenses, budgets, payments, and onboarding.

auth.notes: Uses user tokens passed via the Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN> header.

access.notes: Account and card admins can generate user tokens directly from the Brex dashboard under Settings > Developer.

api_surface.notes: Brex APIs use REST architecture, are defined using OpenAPI, accept and return JSON, and require HTTPS.

mcp.notes: Reported value was discarded: no support offered.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (api_key) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)

evidence.claim: Brex APIs use the REST architecture and include a Webhooks API.
evidence.quote: Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs.

evidence.claim: Authentication uses a bearer token passed in the header.
evidence.quote: To do so, add the header Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TOKEN_FROM_STEP_1_HERE> and make a GET request to https://api.brex.com/v2/users/me with your language/tool of choice.

evidence.claim: Account or card admins can generate API tokens in the dashboard.
evidence.quote: Only account or card admins can create API tokens in the dashboard.

evidence.claim: Tokens are created through the Brex dashboard settings.
evidence.quote: Settings > Developer. You'll have to login as an account admin if you haven't already.

auth.quote: To do so, add the header Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TOKEN_FROM_STEP_1_HERE> and make a GET request to https://api.brex.com/v2/users/me with your language/tool of choice.

access.quote: Check your role permissions and if you’re authorized, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard following these instructions.
